name: AirPods Pro 2 Clone
subtitle: Black TWS earbuds with charging case
description: AirPods Pro 2 Clone Black are TWS in-ear wireless earbuds with Bluetooth 5.0, touch controls, a built-in microphone, and SBC audio codec support. The compact charging case supports wired and wireless charging, while the earbuds work with compatible Android and iOS smartphones.
story: Made for everyday music, calls, and video playback, these black clone-style wireless earbuds use an in-ear design and a compact charging case for convenient carrying. Touch controls allow supported playback and call functions directly from the earbuds, while Bluetooth connectivity enables pairing with compatible smartphones. The case can be recharged using a cable or a compatible wireless charging pad. With a built-in microphone and voice assistant support, they cover common daily listening and communication needs.
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
